d: At least 29 people have been killed in a Russian strike on a humanitarian aid centre in Ukraine's Zaporizhzhia region. As fighting continues, the United States is pushing for fresh peace talks between Russia and Ukraine in Abu Dhabi on November 10-11. Russian President Vladimir Putin has agreed to send a delegation, while US negotiators Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner are expected to lead Washington's team. Meanwhile, Britain and France are preparing for a possible deployment of European troops in Ukraine if a ceasefire is reached. Could the latest peace push finally end the war? And what…
